create_genmd4_model: create a GenMD4 masked diffusion model with configurable data shape, vocab size, and noise schedule
build_masking_schedule: build a learnable vector-valued polynomial masking schedule for discrete diffusion
run_diffusion_loss: run the cont-time diffusion loss with antithetic time sampling and double sampling
test_reinforce_loss: test the REINFORCE-style RLOO loss for policy gradient correction on masked diffusion
review_genmd4_forward_sample: review the forward_sample method that applies state-dependent Bernoulli masking to input tokens
